source: Meet Boston 2026 lights trail; WBUR (Nov 6, 2026); Boston.com

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Boston this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: Boston Common tree lighting
items.blurb: The city lights the Common and the Public Garden, including the spruce Nova Scotia sends every year.
items.blurbEs: La ciudad ilumina el Common y el Public Garden, incluido el abeto que envía Nueva Escocia cada año.

items.name: Commonwealth Avenue Mall lights
items.addr: Commonwealth Ave & Arlington St, Boston, MA 02116
items.blurb: White lights in the trees along the mall, framed by Victorian brownstones. A classic evening walk.
items.blurbEs: Luces blancas en los árboles del paseo, entre casas victorianas. Un clásico paseo nocturno.

items.name: Faneuil Hall tree
items.blurb: One of the city's tallest holiday trees, with white-lit trees all around the marketplace.
items.blurbEs: Uno de los árboles navideños más altos de la ciudad, con árboles de luces blancas alrededor.

items.name: Christopher Columbus Park trellis
items.blurb: A curved trellis glowing blue that you can walk through, right on the harbor.
items.blurbEs: Una pérgola curva iluminada de azul que puedes atravesar, junto al puerto.

items.name: Light Up Seaport
items.blurb: A 52-foot tree with 10,000 lights is switched on next to the Snowport market.
items.blurbEs: Un árbol de 52 pies con 10,000 luces se enciende junto al mercado Snowport.

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays in Boston: Christmas markets, makers fairs and holiday villages running this season.

items.name: Snowport
items.blurb: Boston's biggest holiday market: 125+ vendors, food, themed bars and iceless curling.
items.blurbEs: El mayor mercado navideño de Boston: más de 125 vendedores, comida, bares temáticos y curling sin hielo.

items.name: SoWa Christmas Market
items.blurb: 100+ vendors in a historic power station, with Santa photos and live music.
items.blurbEs: Más de 100 vendedores en una antigua central eléctrica, con fotos con Santa y música en vivo.

items.name: Harvard Square Holiday Fair
items.dates: Dec 11–13 & 18–20; Fri noon–7, Sat 11–7, Sun noon–6
items.addr: 57 John F Kennedy St, Cambridge, MA 02138
items.blurb: A long-running artisan fair with jewelry, pottery and handmade gifts.
items.blurbEs: Una feria de artesanos de larga tradición con joyería, cerámica y regalos hechos a mano.

items.name: Boston Women's Market
items.blurb: More than 30 local, women-owned businesses in one place.
items.blurbEs: Más de 30 negocios locales de mujeres en un solo lugar.
